mapper.sql: r.report_id, r.subject_id, r.period_type, r.period_key, r.period_start, r.period_end, r.budget_amount, r.income_amount, r.expense_amount, r.expense_by_category, r.balance_end, r.loan_out_count, r.loan_unreturned, r.generate_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.deleted, s.name as subject_name, u.nick_name as handler_nickname
mapper.select: select from audit_period_report r left join audit_subject s on r.subject_id = s.subject_id left join sys_user u on s.handler_id = u.user_id where r.report_id = #{reportId} and r.deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into audit_period_report
subject_id, period_type, period_key, period_start, period_end, budget_amount, income_amount, expense_amount, expense_by_category, balance_end, loan_out_count, loan_unreturned, generate_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
values
#{subjectId}, #{periodType}, #{periodKey}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{budgetAmount}, #{incomeAmount}, #{expenseAmount}, #{expenseByCategory}, #{balanceEnd}, #{loanOutCount}, #{loanUnreturned}, #{generateTime}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now()
mapper.update: update audit_period_report set deleted = 1, update_time = now() where report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from audit_fund_flow where subject_id = #{subjectId} and flow_type = 'EXPENSE' and status = 'APPROVED' and deleted = 0 and occur_date <= #{periodEnd}
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from audit_fund_flow where subject_id = #{subjectId} and flow_type = 'INCOME' and status = 'APPROVED' and deleted = 0 and occur_date <= #{periodEnd}
